subject: Draft MAP: Vendor onboarding responsibility matrix and Ariba/Coupa kickoff
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie.ortega@novafinancial.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novafinancial.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP: Vendor onboarding responsibility matrix and Ariba/Coupa kickoff

Thanks again for taking time today, Jamie — great conversation. Per our call, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (RWI_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the onboarding milestone list into owners, dependencies, and target dates so we can drive to a firm procurement activation date. High-level recap: 

- Goal: Complete vendor enrollment (Ariba or Coupa) and have vendor record + banking set up so Redwood can invoice by 2027-01-20.
- Key milestones included in the sheet: vendor forms & W-9, Ariba/Coupa POC and supplier setup, banking/ACH, insurance/SOC evidence if required, and DocuSign for the MSA addendum.
- Suggested target close (commercial go-live): 2027-01-15 (we can slide based on your procurement cadence).

Immediate asks for Nova Financial procurement team: 
1) Confirm preferred P2P system (Ariba vs Coupa) and the POC contact (name/email).
2) Upload vendor questionnaire + vendor form (I attached a stub 'NovaFin_vendor_form.docx' to my notes) or confirm how you prefer to receive it.
3) Provide bank ACH template and W-9.

I've populated the responsibility matrix with recommended internal owners: Aditya (implementation lead) will coordinate the supplier integration, Ben will own billing details and invoice testing, and I will track the MAP and report progress weekly. Marissa is looped for procurement playbook handoff once supplier activation completes.

Next steps: please review the attached MAP and reply with any edits to owners or dates. If procurement can confirm P2P system + POC by Monday 12/21, we can lock the timeline and kick off supplier setup the week of 12/28.

Attachments: [attachment: RWI_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)], [attachment: NovaFin_vendor_form.docx (docx, 28 KB)]

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Vendor onboarding responsibility matrix and Ariba/Coupa kickoff

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap and the spreadsheet. A few notes from procurement after a quick internal sync: 

- We will use Coupa for supplier onboarding. POC: Luis Pena (luis.pena@novafinancial.com) is the systems admin; cc'ing him in a separate follow-up.
- I'll upload our vendor form and the ACH template to the shared Drive this afternoon. I'll also attach the signed W-9 from our side; we typically require a W-9 from you and your payment terms confirmation.
- Procurement flagged insurance and SOC evidence as likely needed — can you confirm you can provide SOC 2 Type II report and an insurance certificate? If you can share SOC evidence, we'll fast-track the supplier review.

On the timeline: 2027-01-15 is reasonable if we get the vendor packet and W-9 to procurement by 12/23. Otherwise, we may slip 1–2 weeks. I'll coordinate with Luis on Coupa steps.

Subject: RE: Draft MAP: Vendor onboarding responsibility matrix and Ariba/Coupa kickoff

Thanks, Jamie — welcome on Coupa. Quick implementation plan excerpted from the MAP: 

1) Immediate (this week): Redwood to provide W-9 (attached) and SOC 2 evidence link; Redwood to fill NovaFin vendor form if preferred. Action owner: Kimberly / Aditya — due 2026-12-23.
2) Coupa supplier setup: Luis (Nova Fin) to create supplier record and invite Redwood — once invited, Aditya will complete the setup and attach invoices for test. Target: 2026-12-28 to 2027-01-05.
3) Banking/ACH verification: Ben to send Redwood's remittance/bank form and coordinate micro-deposit verification. Target complete by 2027-01-08.
4) Commercial go-live & invoice acceptance: target 2027-01-15 pending supplier record activation and SOC review.

I'll attach the SOC link and a clean W-9 in this thread. Also adding a short checklist in the MAP for the Coupa admin steps (POC invite, tax info, invoice sample upload).

Related links: HubSpot deal RWI-2026-4012 (see notes), DocuSign envelope for MSA addendum will be shared by Kimberly when we reach the supplier-activated milestone.
